name: GLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500)
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: GLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500) (BBG) is a multi-component peptide blend supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 1 pack size: 70 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Each unit combines BPC-157 10 mg, GHK-Cu 50 mg and TB-500 10 mg. Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is GLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500) tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: GLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500) is released lot by lot — HPLC for purity (≥99.0% (HPLC)) plus MS for mass — and the BBG certificate lists the measured values alongside the identity entry (CAS 137525-51-0 + 89030-95-5 + 885340-08-9, formula C62H98N16O22 + C14H24CuN6O4 + C38H68N10O14, 1419.5 Da + 403.93 Da + 889 Da Da).

faq.question: How should GLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500) be stored?
faq.answer: Dry powder for GLOW Blend (BPC-157 + GHK-Cu + TB-500): store at −20 °C. Working solution: 2–8 °C, used within the window printed on the BBG lot certificate.
